item.title: Ward 6+ 7 Annual Caucuses will take place on Saturday, February 28th
item.description: On Saturday, February 28, the Ward 6 & 7 Committees will hold their annual caucuses to determine their delegates to the state convention in June. Registration begins at 8:30 am at the Seapoint Bar & Grille on the 1st floor. The caucuses will begin at 9am.
